guideline: Human raters compare generated text to gold text and mark as accurate if meaning is correctly conveyed
Raters score fluency on a 1-5 scale for naturalness and fluency
- Raters mark accuracy by comparing generated text to gold text and indicating if meaning is conveyed correctly; they rate fluency on a 1-5 scale for naturalness.
Raters judge whether the generated text accurately conveys the meaning (accuracy) and rate its naturalness on a 1‑5 scale (fluency).

Human raters are shown the gold text and the predicted text and are instructed to mark the generated text as accurate if it correctly conveys the meaning of the gold text. We show the predicted text to raters and ask them how natural and fluent the text sounds on a 1-5 scale, with 5 being the highest score.
